annotation.evidence_span: A QUIC endpoint MUST NOT reuse a Stream ID.
annotation.interpretation_a: The clause prohibits reusing a stream ID for a new stream while the previous stream is still open.
annotation.interpretation_b: The clause prohibits reusing a stream ID for any new stream, even after the previous stream has closed.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether a Stream ID can be reused after the original stream has closed, leaving two materially different implementation possibilities.
annotation.missing_information: Whether reuse of a Stream ID is allowed after the original stream has been closed and is no longer in use.
